ppac.unit: decimal of energy and fixed charges
ppac.source: TODO_VERIFY: Power Purchase Adjustment Charge, set by DERC per DISCOM and revised through the year; shown on each bill. Tata Power-DDL Customer Handbook FY26 (tatapower-ddl.com, Customer_Handbook_FY26.pdf, March 2026), 'Know your Bill Calculation', step 5.

subsidy.source: Government of NCT of Delhi subsidy for domestic consumers who opt in, under GoNCTD order F.6/24/Power/2021/2447-59 dated 23 Jun 2021, cited in Tata Power-DDL Customer Handbook FY26 (tatapower-ddl.com, March 2026), page 11. Up to 200 units a month the whole bill is subsidised (the handbook's sample bill for 107 units shows a subsidy equal to the full current demand, page 8). From 201 to 400 units the subsidy is 50% capped at ₹800 a month: the handbook's solar leaflet counts ₹9,600 a year (₹800 a month) for the 0-200 and 201-400 unit slabs (page 19); the 50% share is as widely reported. None above 400 units. Continued for 2026-27 per reports of the Delhi budget (₹3,500 crore for power subsidy); no 2026-27 notification found online.

source: DERC domestic tariff applicable from 1 Aug 2019: energy slabs ₹3.00 (0-200 units), ₹4.50 (201-400), ₹6.50 (401-800), ₹7.00 (801-1200), ₹8.00 (above 1200), billed by block; fixed charge per kW of sanctioned load at the rate of the load band (₹20 up to 2 kW, ₹50 above 2 up to 5 kW, ₹100 above 5 up to 15 kW, ₹200 above 15 up to 25 kW, ₹250 above 25 kW); 8% surcharge and 7% pension trust surcharge on energy and fixed charges; 5% electricity tax on energy charges plus PPAC and surcharge on them. Tata Power-DDL Customer Handbook FY26 (tatapower-ddl.com, Customer_Handbook_FY26.pdf, March 2026), pages 8-10. DERC's site (derc.gov.in) could not be reached to cross-check.
